pump_chain_minus.pattern: Shorting chop in EXTREME vol — 16 losses 24h, avg RSI 41.8, all EXTREME regime
pump_chain_minus.root_cause: pump-chain- fires on NEUTRAL chop coins in EXTREME vol. No confirmation of independent downtrend. Bounce eats the short.
pump_chain_minus.recommended_change: Require SHORT_BIAS confirmation (r2>0.6) before pump-chain- fires. OR block EXTREME vol (14d net +$0.90).
pump_chain_minus.impact_on_winners: Blocking EXTREME would give up 20 winners (+$2.82) to save 37 losers (-$3.72). Net +$0.90. 65% of EXTREME trades are losers.
pump_chain_minus.confidence: MEDIUM — n=57 sufficient, but non-EXTREME also negative (-$0.29). Signal may need broader fix.

creative_improvements.idea: 5m momentum gate for chop-entry signals — block trades with |price_change_5m| < 0.15% at entry
creative_improvements.rationale: 91.8% of hard_max_loss trades never reached trail arm. Avg MFE 0.148% = no momentum. A 5m momentum gate would block chop entries before they die.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block ~50% of hard_max_loss trades (those with no 5m momentum). Save ~$3/7d if half of blocked trades would have lost.
creative_improvements.risk: medium — might block slow-starting winners. Backtest required before shipping.
creative_improvements.verification_required: Run backtest on last 30d. Check: (1) How many winners would be blocked? (2) Statistical significance. (3) Out-of-sample at 7d/14d.

creative_improvements.idea: pump-chain- SHORT_BIAS confirmation — require r2>0.6 before firing
creative_improvements.rationale: 14d: pump-chain- loses in ALL regimes. Root cause = shorting NEUTRAL chop coins, not confirmed downtrends. Winners short coins with independent downtrends.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Block chop-shorts, keep trend-shorts. 14d EXTREME block alone = +$0.90. SHORT_BIAS confirmation could be cleaner.
creative_improvements.risk: medium — might reduce frequency. Signal already low-frequency in non-EXTREME.
creative_improvements.verification_required: Backtest r2>0.6 filter on last 30d pump-chain- trades.
